blocker.summary: r454 wired PinnedShaderRuntime into the live VdSwap and ring-drain paths (4 files: native_guest_vd.h/.cpp, native_runtime.h/.cpp, all already carrying pre-existing backlog per r433 -- not committed). drain_locked() now syncs guest memory into the runtime's 512 MiB shared-memory SSBO (r438) and routes decoded commands through execute_frame() instead of VulkanBackend's validate-only submit(); publish_write_address() (the real VdSwap path, r430) routes its present through execute_frame() instead of a plain clear. Found and fixed a real regression within the same cycle: an unpinned-shader rejection from draw_pinned() (expected -- the pinned registry is 271 oracle-derived translations, not exhaustive) was making the WHOLE decoded batch fail, unlike VulkanBackend::submit()'s pure structural validation which never fails on missing render capability -- measured as presented_frames=0 state=1, worse than the r452 baseline of 5/2. Fixed by falling back to plain structural validation for that batch on a pinned rejection, preserving pre-r454 accept/stall behavior exactly while only ever adding real rendering on top, never removing acceptance. Reran: present_count genuinely progresses 1-5 through the real engine (not the clear), 8 clean fallbacks logged, native ctest 11/11. Found but NOT fixed: a real diagnostic desync -- NativeRuntime::diagnostics() (r431) still reads backend_.present_count(), not pinned_'s counter, so presented_frames stays stuck at 0 even when the pinned engine is genuinely presenting. Visual content correctness not verified (no capture/color-hash check attempted). Decision: not committed this cycle -- a real behavioral change layered onto files that already carry substantial backlog, with a known unfixed diagnostic bug and no visual verification, is explicitly first-cut-not-ready, same standard applied to r438's SSBO resize. Named for r455: fix the presented_frames sync bug and capture a real image for visual verification; once mature, reconsider the native_vulkan_backend.cpp/native_guest_vd.cpp/native_runtime.* backlog commit decision (r433/r434/r438/r454, now more entangled). Still open, non-blocking: updating tools/prepare.py/build.py to default to the current ISO path (r452/r453, convenience only).
